electricityContract.terms: This offer applies to customers with an applicable network tariff. To be eligible, you must hold gas and/or electricity accounts on AGL's Business Multi-Property plan for at least two small business supply addresses under the same ABN or ACN; otherwise, AGL may move you to a standard retail contract.For solar feed-in tariff eligibility or further details about terms and conditions, please contact AGL on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au.
electricityContract.variation: This plan has variable rates, fees, and charges, and may include energy payments for (e.g. a Solar Feed-in Tariff) that can change with notice to you. Any increases to your rates, fees or charges or reduction to energy payments will occur in July and you will receive at least five business days' notice. An increase to a tariff or charge or decrease in an energy payment made as a direct result of a tariff reassignment by your distributor may still occur at anytime.
